```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Unique and Permanent Identifiers and Support for Formatting

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop shall provide unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    Given the system is initialized
    When a new requirement is created with a linkable section
    Then a unique identifier is assigned to the linkable section
    Examples:
      | Description of Linkable Section |
      | A linkable section with text     |
      | Another linkable section       |

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop shall support formatting within linkable text
    Given the system is initialized
    When a new requirement is created with formatting in the linkable section
    Then the formatting is preserved in the linkable text
    Examples:
      | Formatting |
      | **bold**   |
      | *italic*  |
      | `code`     |

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop shall support the storage of external requirements assets
    Given the system is initialized
    When an external requirements asset is imported
    Then the asset is stored in the system
    Examples:
      | Asset File Path |
      | /path/to/asset1 |
      | /path/to/asset2 |

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop shall be able to import content from other requirements management tools
    Given the system is initialized
    When content is imported from another tool
    Then the content is correctly parsed and stored
    Examples:
      | Import Source |
      | ToolA         |
      | ToolB         |

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop shall be able to export content to interact with common text/document tools
    Given the system is initialized
    When content is exported to a common text/document tool
    Then the exported content is compatible with the tool
    Examples:
      | Export Format |
      | PDF           |
      | DOCX          |

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop shall provide a way to view requirements as a document
    Given the system is initialized
    When a document view of requirements is requested
    Then the requirements are displayed in a document format
    Examples:
      | View Type |
      | PDF       |
      | DOCX      |

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop shall provide a way to view document items interactively
    Given the system is initialized
    When a document view is accessed
    Then the document items are displayed interactively
    Examples:
      | Interaction Type |
      | Interactive View |
      | Navigation      |

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop shall provide the capability to baseline versions of requirements
    Given the system is initialized
    When a requirement is baselined to a previous version
    Then the baseline version is stored and accessible
    Examples:
      | Requirement ID | Baseline Version |
      | R001           | V1               |
      | R002           | V2               |
```
